dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped light-tan structures on the mid-dorsal flank exhibit sharp gradient transitions from a dark-brown perimeter to high-intensity tan interiors; edges are well-defined and roughly circular.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid, asymmetrical high-intensity light-colored clusters located primarily in the anterior neck-shoulder transition and interspersed between the larger dorsal annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form a scalene triangle; a secondary linear relationship exists between two vertically stacked annuli and a posterior high-intensity blob.
